endpoints.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time server-client communication. Supports status updates, execution progress, feature flag negotiation, and preview images. Query parameter: clientId (optional) - existing session ID to reuse

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Existing session ID to reconnect with

endpoints.returns: web.WebSocketResponse - WebSocket connection for bidirectional communication

endpoints.description: Serves the ComfyUI frontend index.html with no-cache headers
endpoints.returns: web.FileResponse - HTTP 200 with index.html content-type text/html

endpoints.description: Lists all available embedding filenames (without extensions) from the embeddings folder
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with JSON array of embedding names (strings)

endpoints.description: Lists all available model type folder names (e.g., checkpoints, Loras, VAEs)
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with JSON array of model type strings

endpoints.description: Lists all model files in a specific model type folder
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with JSON array of filenames, or HTTP 404 if folder not found

endpoints.description: Lists all JavaScript extension files from the web root and custom node EXTENSION_WEB_DIRS
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with JSON array of extension paths (strings)

endpoints.description: Uploads an image file to the input/output/temp directory. Supports subfolder organization and duplicate detection via hash comparison

parameters.name: subfolder
parameters.description: Subfolder path within the directory type

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: If 'true' or '1', overwrite existing file instead of renaming

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {name, subfolder, type, asset?} or HTTP 400 on error

endpoints.description: Uploads a mask image and applies it as alpha channel to an existing output image referenced by original_ref

parameters.name: original_ref
parameters.description: JSON string with {filename, subfolder?, type?} referencing the output image

parameters.name: subfolder
parameters.description: Subfolder path within the directory type

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {name, subfolder, type, asset?} or HTTP 400/403 on error

endpoints.description: Views or downloads an image file from input/output directories. Supports preview generation, channel extraction (rgb/a), and asset hash resolution

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: Generate preview: 'webp' or 'jpeg' optionally with quality (e.g., 'webp;80')

endpoints.returns: web.Response or web.FileResponse - HTTP 200 with image content, HTTP 400/403/404 on error

endpoints.description: Extracts and returns the __metadata__ from a safetensors file header
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with metadata dict, or HTTP 404 if not found/valid

endpoints.description: Returns system statistics including OS, RAM, VRAM, Python/PyTorch versions, and ComfyUI version info
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with system stats and device info

endpoints.description: Returns server-side feature flags for capability negotiation
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with feature flags dictionary

endpoints.description: Returns current prompt queue status information
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {exec_info: {queue_remaining: int}}

endpoints.description: Returns detailed information about all registered node types including inputs, outputs, categories, and metadata
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with dict mapping node class names to {input, input_order, is_input_list, output, output_is_list, output_name, name, display_name, description, python_module, category, output_node, has_intermediate_output, output_tooltips?, deprecated?, experimental?, dev_only?, api_node?, search_aliases, essentials_category?}

endpoints.description: Returns detailed information about a specific node type

parameters.name: node_class
parameters.description: Node class name to retrieve info for

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with dict {node_class: {input, output, ...}} or empty dict if not found

endpoints.description: List all jobs with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Query parameters: status: Filter by status (comma-separated): pending, in_progress, completed, failed workflow_id: Filter by workflow ID sort_by: Sort field: created_at (default), execution_duration sort_order: Sort direction: asc, desc (default) limit: Max items to return (positive integer) offset: Items to skip (non-negative integer, default 0)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated status filter: pending, in_progress, completed, failed

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {jobs: [...], pagination: {offset, limit, total, has_more}}, or HTTP 400 on invalid params

endpoints.description: Get a single job by ID.
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with job object, HTTP 404 if not found, or HTTP 400 if job_id missing

endpoints.description: Returns execution history (completed/failed prompts) with optional pagination

parameters.name: max_items
parameters.description: Maximum number of history items to return

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with dict mapping prompt IDs to history entries

endpoints.description: Returns history entry for a specific prompt ID

parameters.name: prompt_id
parameters.description: Prompt ID to retrieve history for

endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {prompt_id: history_entry} or empty dict if not found

endpoints.description: Returns current prompt queue status with running and pending items
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with queue_running and queue_pending arrays

endpoints.description: Submits a new prompt workflow for execution. Validates the prompt graph and adds it to the execution queue
endpoints.returns: web.json_response - HTTP 200 with {prompt_id, number, node_errors: {}}, HTTP 400 if prompt invalid or missing

endpoints.description: Manages the prompt queue - can clear all items or delete specific prompt IDs
endpoints.returns: web.Response - HTTP 200 on success

endpoints.description: Interrupts currently running prompt processing. Can target specific prompt_id or do global interrupt

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional object with prompt_id for targeted interrupt

endpoints.returns: web.Response - HTTP 200 on success

endpoints.description: Sets flags to unload models and/or free VRAM after current prompt completes

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Object with unload_models and/or free_memory boolean flags

endpoints.returns: web.Response - HTTP 200 on success

endpoints.description: Manages execution history - can clear all history or delete specific prompt IDs

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: History management object with clear or delete keys

endpoints.returns: web.Response - HTTP 200 on success
